title: Skateboard with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deckGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B35'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FF8C42'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF6B35'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Skateboard deck -->
  <rect x='10' y='38' width='80' height='18' rx='9' fill='url(#deckGrad)' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Deck highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='16' y='42' width='68' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFD166' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Left truck -->
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#A8DADC'/>
  <rect x='24' y='60' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6BB5C9'/>
  
  <!-- Right truck -->
  <rect x='68' y='56' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#A8DADC'/>
  <rect x='70' y='60' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6BB5C9'/>
  
  <!-- Left wheels -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='6' fill='#E8D44D'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <circle cx='32' cy='68' r='6' fill='#E8D44D'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <!-- Right wheels -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='6' fill='#E8D44D'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='6' fill='#E8D44D'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on deck -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='45' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2B2D42'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='45' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2B2D42'/>
  
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M 36 50 Q 50 60 64 50' fill='none' stroke='#2B2D42' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
